rust_summary: the player's network entity id on `NativeServerPlayer` (`entity_id`).
doc_summary: `NativeServerPlayer.entity_id` is the network entity id the player has this session (0 when not known), so hooks that only give entity ids (`living_incoming_damage`, `living_knockback`) can be matched to a player. Bundles need "hooks": @API:server_player_entity_id@.
